IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: TO PROTECT THE LIVES AND ADVANCE THE INTERESTS OF ANIMALS THROUGH THE LEGAL SYSTEM.
IRS990.MissionDesc: THE ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND'S MISSION IS TO PROTECT THE LIVES AND ADVANCE THE INTERESTS OF ANIMALS THROUGH THE LEGAL SYSTEM. THE ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND ACCOMPLISHES THIS MISSION BY FILING HIGH IMPACT LAWSUITS TO PROTECT ANIMALS FROM HARM, PROVIDING FREE LEGAL ASSISTANCE AND TRAINING FOR ANIMAL CRUELTY CASE STAKEHOLDERS TO ENSURE JUSTICE FOR VICTIM ANIMALS, SUPPORTING TOUGH ANIMAL PROTECTION LEGISLATION AND FIGHTING LEGISLATION HARMFUL TO ANIMALS, AND PROVIDING RESOURCES AND OPPORTUNITIES TO LAW STUDENTS AND PROFESSIONALS TO ADVANCE THE EMERGING FIELD OF ANIMAL LAW.
IRS990.Desc: LITIGATION PROGRAMTHE LITIGATION PROGRAM FILES HIGH IMPACT LAWSUITS AGAINST INDIVIDUALS AND INDUSTRIES THAT EXPLOIT ANIMALS, INCLUDING FACTORY FARMS, PUPPY MILLS, RESEARCH LABORATORIES, AND ROADSIDE ZOOS. THE PROGRAM LITIGATES CASES IN STATE AND FEDERAL COURTS WITH THE GOAL OF STOPPING ABUSIVE PRACTICES AND SETTING GROUNDBREAKING PRECEDENT THAT WILL ESTABLISH JUSTICE FOR ANIMALS IN THE LEGAL SYSTEM. IN ADDITION TO SUING ANIMAL ABUSERS, THE LITIGATION PROGRAM OFTEN SUES STATE AND FEDERAL GOVERNMENTS AND AGENCIES TO INVALIDATE LAWS AND REGULATIONS THAT HARM ANIMALS; AND INTERVENES IN LITIGATION TO DEFEND ANIMAL PROTECTION LAWS WHEN THEY ARE UNDER SIEGE FROM INDUSTRIES THAT ABUSE ANIMALS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: CRIMINAL JUSTICE PROGRAMTHE CRIMINAL JUSTICE PROGRAM FOCUSES ON PROTECTING THE LIVES AND ADVANCING THE LEGAL INTERESTS OF ANIMAL VICTIMS BY WORKING TO ACHIEVE THE BEST POSSIBLE OUTCOMES IN ANIMAL CRUELTY CASES. THE PROGRAM IS STAFFED BY ATTORNEYS AND OTHER EXPERTS IN ANIMAL CRUELTY CASEWORK WHO PROVIDE FREE LEGAL ASSISTANCE TO KEY ANIMAL CRUELTY STAKEHOLDERS, INCLUDING PROSECUTORS, LAW ENFORCEMENT, JUDGES, VETERINARIANS, MENTAL HEALTH PROFESSIONALS, SOCIAL WORKERS, AND COURTROOM ANIMAL ADVOCATES. THIS ASSISTANCE INCLUDES SUPPORT AT ALL STAGES OF A POTENTIAL CRUELTY CASE, INCLUDING LEGAL RESEARCH; AMICUS BRIEFS; TRAININGS FOR PROFESSIONALS; INVESTIGATIONS AND NON-CRIMINAL INTERVENTIONS; AND GRANT FUNDING TO HELP COVER THE COSTS OF CARING FOR ANIMAL VICTIMS, FORENSIC WORK, AND SECURING EXPERT WITNESSES. IN ADDITION, THE PROGRAM PRODUCES MODEL ANIMAL PROTECTION LAWS AND AN ANNUAL RANKINGS REPORT AND COMPENDIUM FOR ALL U.S. JURISDICTIONS AND WORKS CLOSELY WITH LAWMAKERS AND ADVOCATES TO HELP STRENGTHEN EXISTING CRIMINAL CRUELTY LAWS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: LEGISLATIVE AFFAIRS PROGRAMTHE LEGISLATIVE AFFAIRS PROGRAM WORKS AT THE LOCAL, STATE, AND FEDERAL LEVELS TO ADVANCE LEGISLATION AND REGULATIONS TO PROTECT THE LIVES AND PROMOTE THE INTERESTS OF ANIMALS AND TO OPPOSE LEGISLATION AND REGULATIONS THAT WOULD BE HARMFUL TO THEIR WELFARE AND INTERESTS. THE PROGRAM ALSO PROVIDES EDUCATIONAL OPPORTUNITIES FOR LAW STUDENTS, ADVOCATES, AND LEGAL PROFESSIONALS BY PROVIDING ENGAGEMENT AT CONFERENCES, SUPPORTER EVENTS, AND THROUGH ONLINE FORUMS. FINALLY, THE PROGRAM WORKS WITH THE ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND'S OTHER DEPARTMENTS TO DEVELOP CAMPAIGNS TO SUPPORT THESE INITIATIVES AND WORKS CROSSPROGRAMMATICALLY TO IDENTIFY OPPORTUNITIES TO EXPAND LEGAL PROTECTIONS FOR ANIMALS ADDRESSING STRATEGIC LEGAL ISSUES IN THE AREAS OF CIVIL AND CRIMINAL LAW.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: ANIMAL LAW PROGRAMTHE ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND'S ANIMAL LAW PROGRAM WORKS CLOSELY WITH LAW STUDENTS AND LAW PROFESSIONALS TO ADVANCE THE EMERGING FIELD OF ANIMAL LAW. WORKING TO EXPAND ANIMAL LAW INTO THE CURRICULUM OF EVERY LAW SCHOOL IN THE COUNTRY, THE ANIMAL LAW PROGRAM COLLABORATES WITH STUDENTS, FACULTY, AND SCHOOL ADMINISTRATIONS TO FACILITATE THE DEVELOPMENT OF ANIMAL LAW COURSES AND ASSISTS STUDENTS IN FORMING ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND STUDENT CHAPTERS. AS PART OF THE ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND'S ANIMAL LAW PROGRAM, THE ORGANIZATION MAKES GRANTS AVAILABLE TO VARIOUS ORGANIZATIONS, LEGAL INSTITUTIONS, INDIVIDUALS, AND ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND STUDENT CHAPTERS AT LAW SCHOOLS ACROSS THE COUNTRY TO SUPPORT THE EFFORTS TO INFORM, EDUCATE, AND TAKE ACTION FOR ANIMAL PROTECTION LAWS. THE ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND GRANTS ARE CRITICAL TO ENCOURAGING THE NEXT GENERATION OF ANIMAL LAWYERS.PRO BONO PROGRAMTHE ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND'S PRO BONO PROGRAM IS THE NATION'S LARGEST LEGAL PRO BONO NETWORK FOR ANIMAL PROTECTION. THE PROGRAM PARTNERS WITH ATTORNEYS AND PRO BONO COORDINATORS ACROSS THE U.S. TO EXPAND THE PRACTICE OF ANIMAL LAW. COLLECTIVELY, LEGAL PROFESSIONALS DONATE THOUSANDS OF HOURS TO THE ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND CASES ANNUALLY. THE DONATED VALUE OF SERVICES FOR 07/01/2024 TO 06/30/2025, INCLUDED IN THE TOTAL EXPENSES OF THE PRO BONO PROGRAM WAS $2,719,342. THE PROGRAM ALSO WORKS TO INCREASE THE UNDERSTANDING OF ANIMAL LAW IN THE LEGAL COMMUNITY BY EDUCATING PROFESSIONALS AT LAW FIRMS AND BAR ASSOCIATION EVENTS AND KEEPING VOLUNTEERS ENGAGED AND UP TO DATE ON THE LATEST DEVELOPMENTS IN THE FIELD.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: IN OCTOBER 2024, THE BOARD ELECTED TO TERMINATE THE ORGANIZATION'S QUASI-ENDOWMENT THAT HAD A $8,247,742 BALANCE AT JUNE 30, 2024, AND CREATED A BOARD-DESIGNATED OPERATING RESERVE IN ITS PLACE. THE ORGANIZATION DEFINES BOARD-DESIGNATED OPERATING RESERVES AS THE PORTION OF "NET ASSETS WITHOUT DONOR RESTRICTIONS" THAT THE BOARD HAS DESIGNATED FOR USE TO SUSTAIN FINANCIAL OPERATIONS IN THE EVENT OF SIGNIFICANT UNBUDGETED INCREASES IN OPERATING EXPENSES AND OR LOSSES IN OPERATING REVENUES. AS PART OF THE DISSOLUTION OF THE QUASI-ENDOWMENT, THE ORGANIZATION ALSO REDUCED THE BALANCE TO FIT ITS NEW POLICY AND DESIGNATED AMOUNT FOR OPERATIONAL USE. THE BOARD HAS ESTABLISHED A GOAL OF MAINTAINING A MINIMUM BOARD-DESIGNATED RESERVE OF THREE MONTHS OF BUDGETED EXPENSES, LESS DEPRECIATION OR $4,781,095 AS OF JUNE 30, 2025.

CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE ORGANIZATION ARE DEDUCTIBLE AS ALLOWED UNDER THE APPLICABLE TAX CODE. THE ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUND ISSUES GRANTS TO ENTITIES AND INDIVIDUALS WHEN PROVIDING THE GRANT ALIGNS WITH ALDF'S MISSION. GRANT ELIGIBILITY IS REVIEWED ON A CASE-BY-CASE BASIS AND GRANTS ARE AWARDED BASED ON WHETHER GRANTEES MEET ESTABLISHED INTERNAL CRITERIA SPECIFIC TO EACH OF ALDF'S PROGRAMS. INTERNATIONAL GRANT MONITORING AND OVERSIGHT IS CONDUCTED THROUGH PROGRAM-SPECIFIC METHODS, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO REVIEWING AND EVALUATING GRANT APPLICATIONS, FOLLOWING SPECIFIC ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA, AND REVIEW OF ITEMIZED RECEIPTS BEFORE GRANTEES ARE ELIGIBLE FOR REIMBURSEMENT. ALL GRANTS ARE REPORTED BASED ON AN ACCRUAL BASIS OF ACCOUNTING CONSISTENT WITH THE ANIMAL LEGAL DEFENSE FUNDS FINANCIAL STATEMENT PREPARATION METHODOLOGY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FORM 990 IS PREPARED BY AN OUTSIDE TAX PROFESSIONAL. THE FINANCE DIRECTOR OR CFO COMPLETES AND RETURNS THE 990 ORGANIZER, WITH INPUT BY APPLICABLE ALDF STAFF, TO THE TAX PROFESSIONAL TO COMPLETE THE FIRST DRAFT FOR REVIEW. THE FIRST DRAFT IS REVIEWED BY THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, CFO, GENERAL COUNSEL, FINANCE DIRECTOR AND OTHER APPLICABLE ALDF STAFF. ANY CORRECTIONS IDENTIFIED ARE ORGANIZED BY THE FINANCE DIRECTOR OR CFO AND SUBMITTED TO THE TAX PROFESSIONAL TO UPDATE AND PREPARE A SECOND DRAFT FOR REVIEW. THE AUDIT COMMITTEE REVIEWS AND COMMENTS ON THE SECOND DRAFT. AFTER THE REVIEW ANY CORRECTIONS WOULD BE ORGANIZED AND SUBMITTED TO THE TAX PROFESSIONAL TO UPDATE AND PREPARE A THIRD DRAFT FOR FINAL REVIEW AND APPROVAL, IF NECESSARY. AFTER APPROVAL BY THE AUDIT COMMITTEE, THE FORM 990 AND RELATED SCHEDULES WILL BE CIRCULATED TO ALL VOTING MEMBERS FOR FINAL APPROVAL. UPON THE BOARD'S FINAL APPROVAL, THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR WILL HAVE AUTHORIZATION TO HAVE THE FORM 990 AND RELATED SCHEDULES FILED WITH THE IRS. THE FILED FORM 990 (PUBLIC COPY) WILL BE MADE AVAILABLE ON THE ALDF WEBSITE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS REVIEW ALL POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST AT LEAST ANNUALLY. ALL DIRECTORS AND MEMBERS OF THE LEADERSHIP TEAM ARE REQUIRED TO COMPLETE A QUESTIONNAIRE DISCLOSING ANY POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST ON AN ANNUAL BASIS. LOANS BETWEEN THE ORGANIZATION AND MEMBERS OF MANAGEMENT AND THE BOARD ARE STRICTLY PROHIBITED. THE ORGANIZATION SEEKS FULL TRANSPARENCY ON ALL RELATIONSHIPS. ANY POTENTIAL CONFLICTS (IN FACT OR APPEARANCE) ARE DISCUSSED OPENLY AND RESOLVED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE ORGANIZATION'S POLICIES AND PROCEDURES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS REVIEW AND APPROVE THE COMPENSATION OF THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR. THE BOARD ALSO REVIEWS THE CFO'S SALARY WHENEVER THE POSITION'S COMPENSATION IS MODIFIED, UNLESS A SIMILAR MODIFICATION OF COMPENSATION IS APPLIED TO ALL OTHER EMPLOYEES. OTHER KEY EMPLOYEES ARE SUBJECT TO THE PAY SCALE DETERMINED BY AN OUTSIDE AGENCY WHO PROVIDE A DETERMINED SALARY SCALE BASED ON JOB DUTIES AND LOCATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL OF THE ORGANIZATION'S GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND OTHER LEGAL FILINGS ARE MAINTAINED IN A SECURE ENVIRONMENT AND HELD AVAILABLE FOR INSPECTION BY TAX AUTHORITIES AND THE GENERAL PUBLIC. TAX RETURNS ARE POSTED ANNUALLY TO WWW.GUIDESTAR.ORG (WHERE THEY ARE AVAILABLE FOR VIEWING AS ELECTRONIC COPIES) AND ON THE ORGANIZATION'S WEBSITE.
